note: Offline demo script for `ai-eda run IR.json --llm fake:tests/data/fake_llm_requirements.json --llm-budget-usd 0`. It replays one canned RequirementExtraction (what a model would return) for the request below; the pipeline grounds every item deterministically, asks for confirmation, and only `--answer confirm_requirements=yes` makes the explicit items user requirements. The scripted client costs nothing, which is why usage states cost 0.0 (a real provider's cost is reported, never assumed).
